title: Vegan Crumble Dumplings
description: A twist on classic dumplings, made with a nutty and flaky crumble topping, perfect for a comforting vegan meal.
instructions: Make the lentil mixture according to package instructions.
Cut the flaky pastry into small squares.
Place a spoonful of the lentil mixture onto the center of each pastry square.
Fold the pastry squares into triangles and press edges to seal.
Place the dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Mix the nutty crumble topping with saudia spices and sprinkle over the dumplings.
Drizzle with water and serve hot.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
